status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

GitHub user rkondakov opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/5735

IGNITE-10785: Test was reworked to prevent hanging.

You can merge this pull request into a Git repository by running:

$ git pull https://github.com/gridgain/apache-ignite ignite-10785

Alternatively you can review and apply these changes as the patch at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/5735.patch

To close this pull request, make a commit to your master/trunk branch
with (at least) the following in the commit message:

This closes #5735

commit 8d569f123e3767049319ee02f0b3fae8fd013948
Author: rkondakov <kondakov87@...>
Date: 2018-12-24T11:38:43Z

IGNITE-10785: Test was reworked to prevent hanging.

gvvinblade, I've reworked TxRollbackAsyncTest#testSynchronousRollback test to prevent hanging if there are any problems occur during transaction rolling back. I've also run test suites which include this test (Cache/MvccCache 6 and 7) to check if everything is fine on TC. I didn't run RunAll because this fix concerns only mentioned suites, so there is no visa from the bot here. Please review and merge.

Github user asfgit closed the pull request at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/5735
